Corollary
[Vanishing Weyl Tensor Forces Vanishing Cotton Tensor] ↗ prop:trace-covariant-derivative-weyl 1. ch7:7.33

If $\dim M\geq 4$ and the Weyl tensor of a Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian manifold vanishes identically, then its Cotton tensor also vanishes.
